## Vir Biotechnology to Participate in the Jefferies 2026 London Healthcare Conference


11/02/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 178 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/628578897/files/doc_news/Vir-Biotechnology-to-Participate-in-the-Jefferies-2026-London-Healthcare-Conference-2026.pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Vir Biotechnology, Inc. (Nasdaq: VIR), today announced that Marianne De Backer, M.Sc., Ph.D., MBA, President and Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Jefferies 2026 London Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, November 18 at 10:30 a.m. GMT / 5:30 a.m. ET in London, United Kingdom.


A live webcast of the fireside chat will be available at[https://investors.vir.bio](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.vir.bio&esheet=54630523&newsitemid=20261102069944&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.vir.bio&index=1&md5=2b3181bbc08fe324967fd099eedc12b1) and will be archived for 30 days.


**About Vir Biotechnology**


Vir Biotechnology, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on powering the immune system to transform lives by discovering and developing medicines for serious infectious diseases and cancer. Its clinical-stage portfolio includes programs for chronic hepatitis delta and multiple PRO-XTEN® dual-masked T-cell engagers across validated targets in solid tumor indications. Vir Biotechnology also has a preclinical portfolio of programs across a range of oncologic malignancies. Vir Biotechnology routinely posts information that may be important to investors on its website.


Vir Biotechnology has exclusive rights to the PRO-XTEN® masking platform for oncology and infectious disease. PRO-XTEN® is a trademark of Amunix Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a Sanofi company.
